W4.content: Repair multi-client session contention (evidence/R05 incident 2026-07-20): two TUI clients attached to one session fight via stall-guard cancels, killing each other's turns; stranded soft-interrupt recovery re-queues user messages so duplicates accumulate and replay (18x duplicate delivery observed); the stall-guard cancellation is mislabeled 'Tool interrupted by server reload'. Fix: (a) duplicate-attach policy: newest client wins with explicit takeover banner on the older client, or at minimum a prominent 'N clients attached' warning on both; (b) collapse identical queued user messages at the turn boundary instead of replaying each copy; (c) label stall-guard cancels truthfully (trigger=stall_guard is already in the interrupt metadata); (d) working-dir integrity: a reconnecting client's Subscribe silently overwrote the session's 13-hour-old working_dir (/Users/jrudnik/labs/jcode -> /Users/jrudnik, env snapshot reason=working_dir at the incident second), silently rescoping swarm identity and relative-path behavior. A reconnect must not change an established session working_dir without explicit confirmation, or must at minimum surface the change loudly.
